candidate: Candidate A - legacy planning_node + tool_execution_node (agent/nodes.py), per docs/v2/PHASE3_GATE_PLAN.md Section 1
methodology_summary: For each of the 59 development+validation benchmark cases: built a ResearchQuery from the case's hand-authored research_query_input dict, converted it via the real nlu.to_legacy_research_plan() adapter, built a minimal AgentState via agent.state.create_initial_state(), then called the REAL agent.nodes.planning_node() followed by agent.nodes.tool_execution_node() - no mocking of the LLM or HTTP calls. Metrics computed post-hoc against each case's gold label and against orchestration/models.py's typed argument schemas (retrospectively, since the legacy pipeline itself does not validate against them).

structural_limitation_get_drug_info.note: tool_execution_node (agent/nodes.py:671-700) has NO dispatch branch for ChEMBLTool.get_drug_info at all - only search_by_target/search_by_indication are reachable via the chembl if/elif's nested query_type dispatch. get_drug_info is only ever called internally by _backfill_chembl_names, never as a primary LLM-selected operation. Any benchmark case whose gold_operation_per_source['chembl'] == 'get_drug_info' is therefore STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE by Candidate A - operation accuracy for those cases is 0% by construction, not a model failure.

parameter_quality.malformed_calls_reaching_executor_note: Legacy tool_execution_node has NO parameter-schema validation gate before calling the real tool method (audit Section C) - a schema-invalid params dict (per orchestration/models.py) still reaches the real tool call. This count is the number of LLM-generated parameter sets that failed retrospective validation against the orchestration/models.py schema but were executed anyway.
parameter_quality.semantically_invalid_parameter_rate: NOT MEASURED - requires a semantic judge (LLM-as-judge or manual annotation), out of scope for a deterministic reproduction run; not fabricated.
parameter_quality.canonicalization_correctness_note: Covered by schema_valid_rate for clinical_trials status/phase, since ClinicalTrialsSearchArgs enforces VALID_TRIAL_STATUSES/VALID_TRIAL_PHASES at construction (orchestration/models.py) - a case with an invalid status/phase value shows up as schema_valid=False above.

execution_safety_hard_gates.arbitrary_model_generated_callable_execu: No eval/exec/dynamic-import from LLM output anywhere in agent/nodes.py or tools/*.py (confirmed by PHASE3_INITIAL_ORCHESTRATION_AUDIT.md Section D and by direct source inspection during this run). Not independently re-verified beyond the audit for this measurement task.
execution_safety_hard_gates.arbitrary_model_generated_url_execution_: All three tools call fixed, hardcoded base API URLs (tools/pubmed_tool.py, tools/clinical_trials_tool.py, tools/chembl_tool.py) - the LLM only supplies query PARAMETERS, never a URL. Not independently re-verified beyond static audit for this run.
execution_safety_hard_gates.schema_invalid_call_reaching_executor_no: Candidate A FAILS this hard gate (Section 3 of the gate plan) by construction - it has no schema validation boundary at all (audit Section C). See parameter_quality.malformed_calls_reaching_executor_count above for the measured count on this benchmark.
execution_safety_hard_gates.secret_or_auth_header_in_trace_note: Manually inspected tool_call_history/params/query fields recorded by this run: all three tools are unauthenticated public GET APIs (audit Section G), no Authorization header exists in any tool client, and no API key string appeared in any recorded query/params/error field during this run.
execution_safety_hard_gates.call_without_traceable_call_id_note: AgentState/tool_call_history (agent/state.py, agent/nodes.py) has NO call_id field anywhere - every real tool call made in this run lacked a traceable call_id by construction. Candidate A fails this hard gate by construction, not due to any per-case anomaly.
execution_safety_hard_gates.unknown_tool_silent_fallback_note: Verified empirically in this run: every tools_to_call entry not in {pubmed, clinical_trials, chembl} was recorded as a failed tool_call_history entry (success=False) and never silently substituted for a real tool - matches audit Section B.

execution_reliability.retry_count: NOT MEASURED - tool_call_history (agent/nodes.py:721-729) does not record retry counts; retries happen transparently inside utils/retry_handler.py's RetrySession and are invisible at the orchestration layer (audit Section G).
execution_reliability.recovered_failures_via_retry: NOT MEASURED - same reason as retry_count.
execution_reliability.error_category_heuristic_note: Legacy ToolResult.error/tool_call_history['error'] is free text (tools/base_tool.py handle_errors dict-lookup), not a typed ToolErrorCategory (orchestration/models.py). Rates above are string-matched heuristics (substring search for 'timeout'/'429'/'rate limit'/'http') over the free-text error field, NOT a true typed-category measurement - reported as heuristic, not fabricated as exact.

multi_source.parallel_execution_success: N/A - Candidate A executes tools strictly sequentially, one Python for-loop, no asyncio/ThreadPoolExecutor (audit Section F, agent/nodes.py:623). There is no parallel path to measure.

performance_latency_ms.per_tool_call_breakdown: NOT MEASURED - tool_call_history (agent/nodes.py:721-729) does not record a per-call start timestamp or latency_ms field (only a completion timestamp), so per-tool-call latency cannot be reconstructed from the real recorded state without instrumenting/patching production code, which this measurement task avoided to keep the run a faithful reproduction. tool_execution_stage_total_per_case (above) is the real, measured total latency for the whole tool-calling stage per case (all tool query-gen LLM calls + all tool HTTP calls + ChEMBL name-backfill calls, sequential).

cost.input_output_token_breakdown: NOT MEASURED SEPARATELY - _accumulate_tokens (agent/nodes.py:79-92) sums usage_metadata['total_tokens'] only; per-call input/output split is available on individual LangChain response objects but not persisted anywhere in AgentState, so it cannot be recovered per-case after the fact without re-instrumenting the node function.
cost.dollar_cost_per_query: NOT MEASURED - no per-token pricing configuration exists anywhere in this codebase for the NVIDIA NIM key used (config/llm_config.py); computing a dollar figure would require an externally-sourced price this run did not verify against actual billing, so it is omitted rather than estimated.

traceability.valid_call_id_rate_note: Structural 0% - AgentState/tool_call_history has no call_id field anywhere in agent/state.py or agent/nodes.py (audit Section G). Every real tool call in this run lacked one by construction, not due to any per-case failure.
traceability.execution_result_linked_to_call_rate: N/A - same reason as valid_call_id_rate; there is no call_id to link results back to.
traceability.error_category_completeness_note: Structural 0% against the typed ToolErrorCategory enum (orchestration/models.py) - legacy errors are free-text strings only (tools/base_tool.py handle_errors). See execution_reliability's heuristic breakdown for a best-effort string-matched approximation, explicitly labeled heuristic.
traceability.sanitized_trace_completeness_note: Manually verified: no secret/API-key string appeared in any tool_call_history/params/query/error field recorded during this run (all three tools are unauthenticated public GET APIs).

abstention_handling.note: Confirmed empirically, not just from the audit: planning_node (agent/nodes.py:488-576) has no branch that can produce an empty tools_to_call by design - the prompt always asks the LLM to pick from the 3-tool catalog, and the exception fallback is ['pubmed','clinical_trials','chembl'] (all three), never []. There is no PlanStatus.NO_EXECUTION_NEEDS_CLARIFICATION equivalent anywhere in agent/nodes.py or agent/state.py. This is a NAMED LIMITATION of Candidate A, not a silently-absorbed gap: for every ambiguous_abstain benchmark case in development+validation (gold.abstention_expected=true), Candidate A will attempt real tool execution instead of abstaining/asking for clarification.
